content.title: Alkermes (ALKS) Is Up 6.6% After FDA Breakthrough Tag for Narcolepsy Drug Alixorexton
content.summary: Earlier this month, Alkermes plc announced that the FDA granted Breakthrough Therapy designation to alixorexton, its oral selective orexin 2 receptor agonist, for narcolepsy type 1 based on positive phase 1 and phase 2 data, including the large Vibrance-1 study. The designation underscores alixorexton’s potential to improve on existing narcolepsy type 1 treatments and could accelerate development of Alkermes’ broader orexin agonist franchise across multiple sleep disorders.
